tiles.title: Average TTFT
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH latest_ts AS (
  SELECT metric_name, "__series_hash" AS series_hash, MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
  FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.time_to_first_token' AND ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')
  GROUP BY metric_name, "__series_hash"
)
SELECT ROUND(SUM(m.data_point_sum)/NULLIF(SUM(m.data_point_count),0),3) AS avg_ttft_s
FROM $metrics_dataset m JOIN latest_ts l
  ON m.metric_name=l.metric_name AND m."__series_hash"=l.series_hash AND m.p_timestamp=l.latest
WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')

tiles.title: SDK vs Provider Latency (Native Metrics)
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH base AS (
  SELECT date_bin('1 minute',p_timestamp,'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,p_timestamp,metric_name,
    "__series_hash" AS series_hash,data_point_sum,data_point_count
  FROM $metrics_dataset
  WHERE metric_name IN ('gen_ai.client.operation.duration','gen_ai.client.response.duration') AND ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')
), latest AS (
  SELECT time_bin,metric_name,series_hash,MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest_ts FROM base GROUP BY time_bin,metric_name,series_hash
), points AS (
  SELECT b.* FROM base b JOIN latest l ON b.time_bin=l.time_bin AND b.metric_name=l.metric_name
    AND b.series_hash=l.series_hash AND b.p_timestamp=l.latest_ts
)
SELECT time_bin,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.operation.duration')/
    NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.operation.duration'),0),4) AS sdk_operation_s,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.duration')/
    NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.duration'),0),4) AS provider_response_s
FROM points GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

WITH base AS (
  SELECT date_bin('1 minute',p_timestamp,'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,p_timestamp,metric_name,
    "__series_hash" AS series_hash,data_point_sum,data_point_count
  FROM $metrics_dataset
  WHERE metric_name IN ('gen_ai.client.response.time_to_first_token','gen_ai.client.response.time_per_output_token') AND ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')

  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')
), latest AS (
  SELECT time_bin,metric_name,series_hash,MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest_ts FROM base GROUP BY time_bin,metric_name,series_hash
), points AS (
  SELECT b.* FROM base b JOIN latest l ON b.time_bin=l.time_bin AND b.metric_name=l.metric_name
    AND b.series_hash=l.series_hash AND b.p_timestamp=l.latest_ts
)
SELECT time_bin,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.time_to_first_token')/
    NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.time_to_first_token'),0),4) AS avg_ttft_s,
  ROUND(SUM(data_point_sum) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.time_per_output_token')/
    NULLIF(SUM(data_point_count) FILTER (WHERE metric_name='gen_ai.client.response.time_per_output_token'),0),4) AS avg_time_per_output_token_s
FROM points GROUP BY time_bin ORDER BY time_bin

  COUNT(*) AS spans
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
GROUP BY service,environment,language,sdk,sdk_version,integration ORDER BY spans DESC

tiles.title: Logs by Severity
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT date_bin('1 minute',p_timestamp,'1970-01-01T00:00:00Z') AS time_bin,
  COALESCE(severity_text,'unknown') AS severity,COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$severity' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, 'unknown') = '$severity')
GROUP BY time_bin,severity ORDER BY time_bin,severity

tiles.title: SDK Log Events
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT COALESCE(body_event,'instrumentation') AS event,COUNT(*) AS logs
FROM $logs_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$severity' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, 'unknown') = '$severity')
GROUP BY event ORDER BY logs DESC

tiles.title: Recent SDK Request/Response Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,severity_text,body_event,body_scenario,body_model,
  body_streaming,body_input_tokens,body_output_tokens,trace_id,span_id,body
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$severity' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, 'unknown') = '$severity') AND body_event IN ('llm.request','llm.response')

tiles.title: Recent Error Logs
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,severity_text,body_scenario,
  "body_error.type" AS error_type,"body_error.message" AS error_message,
  trace_id,span_id,body
FROM $logs_dataset
WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$severity' = 'All' OR COALESCE(severity_text, 'unknown') = '$severity') AND (severity_number>=17 OR severity_text='ERROR' OR body_event='llm.error')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Logs with Trace Context
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT l.p_timestamp,l.severity_text,l.body_event,l.body_scenario,l.body_model,
  l.trace_id,l.span_id,t.span_name,
  ROUND(t.span_duration_ns/1000000.0,3) AS span_duration_ms,
  CASE WHEN t.span_status_code=2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS span_status,
  l.body
FROM $logs_dataset l
LEFT JOIN $traces_dataset t ON l.trace_id=t.span_trace_id AND l.span_id=t.span_span_id
WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l."service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l."deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$severity' = 'All' OR COALESCE(l.severity_text, 'unknown') = '$severity')
ORDER BY l.p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent LLM Calls
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,span_trace_id,span_span_id,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name",'unknown') AS provider,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model",'unknown') AS request_model,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.response.model",'unknown') AS response_model,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000000.0,4) AS duration_s,
  CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.input_tokens",'0') AS DOUBLE) AS input_tokens,
  CAST(COALESCE("gen_ai.usage.output_tokens",'0') AS DOUBLE) AS output_tokens,
  ROUND(COALESCE("gen_ai.cost.total_cost",0),8) AS cost_usd,
  CASE WHEN span_status_code=2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'ok' END AS status
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') = '$provider')
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND span_kind_description = 'CLIENT'
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Error Traces
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,span_trace_id,span_span_id,span_name,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name",'unknown') AS provider,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model",'unknown') AS model,
  "http.response.status_code" AS http_status,
  COALESCE("error.type","event_exception.type",span_status_description,'unknown') AS error_type,
  COALESCE("error.message","event_exception.message",span_status_message,'unknown') AS error_message,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,3) AS duration_ms
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.provider.name", 'unknown') = '$provider')
  AND "gen_ai.request.model" IS NOT NULL
  AND span_kind_description = 'CLIENT' AND (span_status_code=2 OR "error.type" IS NOT NULL)
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Scenario Trace Roots
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,span_trace_id,span_span_id,
  COALESCE("scenario.name",'unknown') AS scenario,
  COALESCE("scenario.status",CASE WHEN span_status_code=2 THEN 'error' ELSE 'unset' END) AS outcome,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000000.0,4) AS duration_s,
  span_status_message
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment') AND span_name='sdk.scenario'
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

tiles.title: Recent Span Timeline Data
tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT p_timestamp,span_trace_id,span_span_id,span_parent_span_id,
  span_name,span_kind_description,
  COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model","scenario.name",'unknown') AS model_or_scenario,
  ROUND(span_duration_ns/1000000.0,3) AS duration_ms,
  CASE WHEN span_status_code=2 THEN 'error' WHEN span_status_code=1 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'unset' END AS status
FROM $traces_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
ORDER BY p_timestamp DESC,span_start_time_unix_nano ASC LIMIT 200

tiles.title: Latest Native Metric Rollup
tiles.chartQuery:
WITH latest_ts AS (
  SELECT metric_name,"__series_hash" AS series_hash,MAX(p_timestamp) AS latest
  FROM $metrics_dataset WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE("service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE("deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE("gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')
  GROUP BY metric_name,"__series_hash"
)
SELECT m.metric_name,
  COALESCE(m."gen_ai.system",'unknown') AS provider,
  COALESCE(m."gen_ai.request.model",'unknown') AS model,
  COALESCE(m."gen_ai.token.type",'all') AS token_type,
  SUM(m.data_point_count) AS observations,
  ROUND(SUM(m.data_point_sum),8) AS cumulative_sum,
  ROUND(SUM(m.data_point_sum)/NULLIF(SUM(m.data_point_count),0),6) AS cumulative_avg,
  MIN(m.min) AS min_value,MAX(m.max) AS max_value,m.metric_unit
FROM $metrics_dataset m JOIN latest_ts l
 ON m.metric_name=l.metric_name AND m."__series_hash"=l.series_hash AND m.p_timestamp=l.latest
WHERE ('$service' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."service.name", 'unknown') = '$service')
  AND ('$environment' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."deployment.environment", 'unknown') = '$environment')
  AND ('$model' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."gen_ai.request.model", 'unknown') = '$model')
  AND ('$provider' = 'All' OR COALESCE(m."gen_ai.system", 'unknown') = '$provider')
GROUP BY m.metric_name,provider,model,token_type,m.metric_unit
ORDER BY m.metric_name,provider,model,token_type

tiles.chartQuery:
SELECT metric_name,metric_type,metric_unit,metric_description,
  COALESCE("service.name",'unknown') AS service,
  COALESCE("deployment.environment",'unknown') AS environment,
